title: Dear Maya
desc: Anna and Ira prank a local woman by writing her letters from a secret admirer. However, the prank takes a more serious turn when the local woman goes missing.

title: Joshila Janbaz
desc: Bhagvathi, a tea vendor, has big dreams for his younger brother, Guna. However, Guna gets killed by his girlfriend's father, who is unaware that his daughter is pregnant.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Prostitute, Madhu, agrees to be the surrogate mother of Raj and Priya's baby in exchange for a million rupees. Everything soon changes when Madhu develops feelings for both the baby and Raj.

title: Astitva
desc: The movie follows the story of Aditi, a devoted wife, who discovers her husband's infidelity. As she confronts her husband and delves deeper into the truth, she begins to question her own identity and place in society.

title: Dharam Chakara (dharam Chakaram Tamil 1997)
desc: A village leader who loses a fight to his enemy Arumugam, causing the death of his lover Vijayalakshmi. Years later, another woman named Vijayalakshmi enters the village, and Chakkaravarthy defends her from Arumugam's goons, rekindling his fight for justice.
